composition_label: Document review -> Semantic search -> Feedback analysis

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory; clearly labeled synthetic fixture data.

input.requirements: List of {id, description, terms: nonempty string list}.
input.feedback: List of {id, document_id, text}; document references must resolve.
input.themes: List of {id, terms}; id 'other' is reserved for unmatched feedback.

output.envelope: {schema_version, status, stage, input, review, semantic, feedback}; later-stage fields are added only after prior-stage validation.
output.review: Notice and per-requirement checks: supported/partial/gap, missing_terms, evidence with document and requirement IDs, verbatim excerpt, and character offsets.
output.semantic: Retrieval mode, evidence search index, and ranked hits with evidence/document/requirement IDs and finite scores.
output.feedback: Deduplicated groups retaining source IDs, document IDs, search evidence IDs, theme IDs, theme-specific verbatim supporting excerpts and character offsets; unique group counts per theme; excluded source IDs; duplicate count.
output.error: {status: error, error: message}; CLI exit code 2.

validation: One shared validation module validates inputs and every stage boundary.
Objects reject unknown/missing keys; list collections allow at most 500 records, text at most 20000 characters, term lists 1..50 terms.
IDs are unique within each collection; normalized terms cannot repeat; empty collections are permitted.
Review and final feedback outputs are checked against deterministic derivations; the semantic index must exactly preserve review evidence.
Search hits require valid cross-stage references, unique evidence IDs, finite positive scores at most 1, bounded count and deterministic ordering.
Offsets are zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode character indices.
CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON constants, malformed input, bad encoding, invalid arguments and file access errors.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated envelope containing original input and term-matched evidence. Only this evidence is indexed; missing requirements remain traceable but do not invent searchable evidence.
Validated search hits restrict analysis to feedback associated with retrieved documents. Groups retain the hit evidence IDs, original feedback IDs and source excerpts.

behavior.review: Case-insensitive contiguous word-token phrase matching. A requirement is supported when all terms occur across the supplied documents, partial when some occur, and a gap when none occur. Each term/document pair supplies its first occurrence with up to 80 surrounding characters on each side. This does not establish correctness, entailment, certification or compliance.
behavior.search: Default lexical relevance is the fraction of unique query tokens present in each evidence excerpt plus document title. Positive scores are rounded to eight decimals, sorted descending with evidence-ID tie breaks, then limited. Multiple evidence items from one document can occupy multiple hits.
behavior.optional_embedding: Python run_pipeline(data, embedder=callable) accepts a local injected batch callable(list[str]) -> list[list[number]]. The first text is the query, followed by indexed texts. Nonempty equal-dimensional finite nonzero vectors are required, at most 4096 dimensions. Hybrid score is the mean of lexical relevance and cosine similarity clipped to [0,1]. Norm computation is scaled for large floats. Empty indexes skip invocation. Callable failures become ValidationError. No provider is configured or contacted; fixtures supply deterministic vectors.
behavior.feedback: Filter by retrieved document IDs, then deduplicate by case-folded word-token sequence, ignoring punctuation and whitespace. Preserve all relevant original source IDs. Match configured phrase themes; multiple themes are allowed. Theme counts count unique deduplicated groups, not raw source records. Each theme gets supporting excerpts around matching terms; 'other' gets the first 240 characters. No-match searches yield empty feedback groups and list all source IDs as excluded.
behavior.determinism: No clocks, randomness or live models participate in results. Input is copied, not mutated. An injected callable is responsible for its own determinism.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; exit 0 on success and 2 for validation/file errors. Python API validation errors raise ValidationError.

included: One integrated pipeline and shared envelope/validation layer
Traceable term-level requirements and evidence gaps
In-memory evidence index and deterministic ranking
Optional injected embedding interface exercised with local fixtures
Feedback deduplication, explicit themes and supporting source excerpts
Synthetic fixtures, executable CLI and unittest coverage
excluded: LLM entailment or automatic theme generation
Live providers, networking and third-party dependencies
Semantic duplicate detection, sentiment inference or multilingual guarantees
Production security, throughput guarantees, external document parsing and enterprise deployment

coverage: Review statuses, exact evidence offsets and word boundaries
Index provenance, ranking, ties and limit
Feedback deduplication, themes and late-term supporting excerpts
Cross-document duplicate provenance and query propagation
Review gaps, empty collections, no results and empty embedding batches
Invalid inputs and corrupted stage handoffs
Injected embedding success, invalid vectors, failures and numerical stability
CLI success, missing files, arguments, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite values, encoding errors
